title: build(deps-dev): bump happy-dom from 20.14.0 to 20.14.3
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. happy-dom 20.14.0 -> 20.14.3 in packages/client (devDependency: the vitest DOM environment). Three patch releases, all CSS computed-style fixes: 20.14.1 invalidates the computed-style cache for the whole subtree; 20.14.2 fixes a regression where not all CSS variables were resolved in getComputedStyle(); 20.14.3 avoids cloning all properties in CSSPropertyManager.toString. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: none in the shipped app -- test environment only. Lockfile audited against merge base 7685411c by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly 1 node_modules entry changed: happy-dom 20.14.0 -> 20.14.3, changing only version, resolved and integrity; its own dependency map is unchanged. Zero packages added, zero removed, no other entry touched. The root entry differs in one key, devDependencies.happy-dom ^20.14.0 -> ^20.14.3. happy-dom is the vitest default environment (packages/client/vitest.config.ts: environment "happy-dom") and is imported by four audio-analyzer specs; it is not bundled into the application. The only plausible effect is on test assertions that depended on the pre-20.14.2 CSS-variable resolution bug; CI's vitest run is the check for that.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared devDependency range for happy-dom from ^20.14.0 to ^20.14.3 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves it: happy-dom 20.14.0 -> 20.14.3. No incidental version movement; the added, removed and non-happy-dom changed sets are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior happy-dom-20.14.0-bump manifest and other dependency manifests would each cover these two files, and borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
